notes: bergot_conjecture (A026002_mathlib.lean): every array m with m(n,1) = m(1,n) = n(n-1)+1 (n >= 1) and m(i,j) = m(i,j-1) + m(i-1,j-1) + m(i-1,j) (i, j >= 2) has m(n,n) = A026002 n = D(n-1,n+1) for n >= 1, D the Delannoy array. Via array_formula: 2 m(i,j) = D(i-1,j+1) + D(i+1,j-1) (both terms satisfy the recurrence; borders match using D(1,j) = 2j+1, D(2,j) = 2j^2+2j+1), and D_symm on the diagonal. bergot_boundary_left/top, bergot_rec, bergot_diag: the recursively built array meets the hypotheses. A026002_one/two/three: 1, 7, 41. Axioms propext, Quot.sound (Classical.choice also for bergot_boundary_*, bergot_diag). Outside Lean: reading the entry name T(n,n+2) as D(n-1,n+1) beyond n <= 3 (certificate/check.py: b-file 200 terms and Deutsch's formula for n <= 220).
